items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I enjoyed working with Orrin, it was quite an experience... He was that kind of guy, he would work with you... I think Orrin had something to do with it.

ctx.x: Well I would say this is around late 60’s early 70’s before you got with Milestone, because Milestone, that launches a whole other epoch in your career.
Yeah, Orrin [Keepnews] was a good guy.
So we’ll talk about that, but was that accurate? It was a rough time.
